natural_body: Deep discounts spike signups +31% but risk renewal. Use tactically with guardrails.

first.rationale: Both activation and onboarding completion are down this quarter, and two independent prior experiments (memory_86, memory_31) show durable, low-risk gains from simplifying onboarding/reducing signup friction, directly addressing the observed metric declines. Promotional pricing (memory_73) could counter competitor pressure short-term but is explicitly flagged as risking renewal/long-term qualified revenue, conflicting with the primary objective, so it's deprioritized rather than chosen despite competitive pressure. Referral and enterprise-assist directions address different funnel stages and don't match this week's most pressing metric declines. Verifying the two onboarding-related memories before committing the single experiment slot ensures the original effect sizes and conditions still hold, since this is the highest-leverage, lowest-risk lever available. Scale is set to a standard experiment rather than broad rollout to preserve ability to detect if current conditions (e.g., competitor pricing pressure) have changed the effect, and to avoid overcommitting before reconfirmation.
